english_definition: A person who has been invited to present a speech at an event where they are not the host.
To grasp another person's hands as an expression of greeting, farewell, agreement, etc.
To produce or set (something) down in writing; to record something.
To bring about; to lead to.
a speech setting forth the keynote
To make a record of what one hears or observes for future reference.
An item such as a prop, slide, or picture that appeals primarily to vision and is used to enhance the understanding of information presented orally or in writing.
To be late; to fail to be on time.
To unwillingly stay seated until the end of an event.
A possibility that is not likely or probable.
To speak or act in support or defense of (a person, a cause, a belief, or the like).
a meeting of heads of governments
